bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for grants for lead risk assessments.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GRANTS FOR LEAD RISK ASSESSMENTS.

(a) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for grants to the Minneapolis Health Department and the St. Paul-Ramsey County Public Health Department to conduct lead risk assessments under Minnesota Statutes, section 144.9504, for children with elevated blood levels. Of this appropriation:

(1) $250,000 is for a grant to the Minneapolis Health Department; and

(2) $250,000 is for a grant to the St. Paul-Ramsey County Public Health Department.

(b) The commissioner must not use any of this appropriation for administration.

(1) $250,000 is for a grant to the Minneapolis Health Department; and

(b) The commissioner must not use any of this appropriation for administration.
